name: Wispr Flow
author: Michael Curtis
description: Slide-in dictation indicator for Wispr Flow on Linux: mic and live level meter while listening, pulsing hourglass while transcribing.

barWidget.description: Hidden while idle; slides in next to the indicators with a live mic meter while Wispr Flow is listening.

schema.label: Show the live level meter
schema.description: Samples the default microphone with pw-record while Wispr Flow is listening.

schema.label: Wispr Flow process name
schema.description: Binary name of the PipeWire capture stream that means Wispr Flow is listening.
